name: com.scriptmasterlabs/hive402
title: SCRIPTMASTERLABS — HIVE402
description: Live x402 market for AI agents: 43k paid endpoints, 2,188 sellers, verified payable, 6 rails.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search live paid x402 endpoints settled by OMNIGATE or 402Proof, filtered by text, network and max price.

query.description: Words to match in name, description or seller host.

network.description: Base, Arc, XRPL, Xahau, Solana, MultiversX, or a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453.

max_price.description: Maximum price per call in the listing's asset units.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get full details for one marketplace listing by id, including example input and output.

tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: Request a listing unpaid and return its live x402 payment challenge plus the exact steps to pay through OMNIGATE or 402Proof. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: list_endpoint
tools.description: List your own x402 endpoint in the market for free. It is called unpaid and listed only if it returns a valid x402 v2 challenge on an OMNIGATE or 402Proof network. Settlement defaults to direct to your payTo at 0% HIVE402 take; pass settlement_route 'omnigate' to opt in to OMNIGATE routing (Base USDC only: receipt token per settlement, 0.005 USDC fee inside settlement, waived inside the daily budget).

url.description: Full https URL of the paid endpoint.

method.description: HTTP method buyers use, default GET.

tools.name: plan_mission
tools.description: Suggest up to three live catalog services for a task on one payment rail, within a spending ceiling. No payment or task execution occurs; review endpoint inputs and fee legs. Rail and asset must be a settleable pair (canonical map, src/rails.mjs): Base/Arc/Solana settle in USDC, XRPL in XRP or RLUSD, Xahau in XAH, MultiversX in EGLD, MEX or USDC — any other pair is rejected with an error, never silently re-railed.

budget.description: Spending ceiling as a decimal string, up to 6 decimal places.

asset.description: Asset label; must pair with network: Base→USDC, Arc→USDC, XRPL→XRP or RLUSD, Xahau→XAH, Solana→USDC, MultiversX→EGLD, MEX or USDC.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description: Get reusable catalog-matched task templates with current listing IDs on a single rail. Templates are not verified completed workflows; budget is expressed in atomic units.

tools.name: check_services
tools.description: Probe up to three catalog endpoints unpaid and rank valid live payment challenges by observed response time. Does not measure historical uptime, paid success or outcome quality.

tools.name: prepare_mission_step
tools.description: Recheck an approved listing's current x402 challenge against expected payout, rail, price and remaining atomic budget. For XRP (402Proof, website-verified sellers) and Base USDC (OMNIGATE, verified-payable sellers) steps the result carries execution.available with an executionToken when tracked execution is offered. Caller must inspect fees and sign; this tool never pays.

approved.description: Confirm the caller reviewed and approved the plan. Not wallet authorization.

tools.name: check_watchlist
tools.description: Compare caller-held snapshots with the live public catalog for price, payment-term and catalog-presence changes. Callers retain snapshots and schedule polling; no push delivery.

tools.name: submit_mission_payment
tools.description: Submit a caller-signed Mission payment for a prepared step and record confirmed settlement once. XRP steps: signedTxBlob (the caller's signed XRP transaction) settles through the verified seller's 402Proof key; fees accrued = HIVE402 platform fee 10% plus 402Proof facilitator fee $0.0100, kept separate. Base USDC steps: paymentPayload (decoded x402 payload object carrying the EIP-3009 signature + authorization) or paymentSignature (the same payload base64-encoded, as in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) settles through OMNIGATE; fees accrued = HIVE402 platform fee 10% plus the OMNIGATE facilitator fee from the settlement receipt (0.005 USDC when charged, 0 when waived), kept separate. Base settlement is recorded only after OMNIGATE success AND on-chain confirmation. Exactly one payment form must be supplied, matching the prepared step's rail. Never signs or holds funds; does not execute seller task inputs.

signedTxBlob.description: XRP steps only: the caller-signed XRP transaction blob (hex).

paymentSignature.description: Base steps only: base64-encoded x402 payment payload (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value) carrying the caller's EIP-3009 signature and authorization.

paymentPayload.description: Base steps only: the decoded x402 payment payload object (alternative to paymentSignature).

tools.name: list_board_posts
tools.description: Read the HIVE402 Board — the market's public message board: ScriptMasterLabs announcements, system posts generated at read time from live catalog and subscription data (aggregate counts only), and posts from claimed operator profiles (new products, upgrades, announcements, requests). Free and read-only. The same content is at GET /api/public/board.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Describe what you need; get the best payable x402 endpoint plus fallbacks, each re-challenged live seconds ago, with payment requirements and exact call instructions. Optionally validates your input against each candidate's schema.

tools.name: proxy_call
tools.description: Forwards one call to a catalog listing. Without payment_signature returns the decoded 402 challenge. With payment_signature (base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you signed) forwards it untouched and returns the seller's response and receipt. HIVE402 never signs or re-sends a paid call.

tools.name: search_ranked
tools.description: Search the catalog ranked by relevance × trust × on-chain demand × latency × price, with score breakdowns and intel fields.

tools.name: get_trust
tools.description: Explained 0–100 trust score for one listing: probe uptime, on-chain demand, call spec, latency, operator claim, and junk/sanctions flags.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Side-by-side price, trust, uptime, latency and real demand for 2–10 listings.

tools.name: validate_input
tools.description: Check an input against a listing's call spec and get the exact request to send.
